summary: One behavior: the tier-4 organisms land as CreatureDef data with their simulation-side section 52 scale rules (speed mismatch F, fauna-first environment reaction D, sonar-scale signal E, non-targetable presences) and each organism's signature rule is proven by one headless scenario through the scenario harness using the production simulation. Exactly three named responsibilities change (world content data, creature simulation, headless scenario tests), at the cap; the per-organism scenarios and non-targetable/spoiler checks are evidence for the same behavior, not separate features, and the section 46 colossal-test and 11.2 anti-cliche gates are carried in. Criteria AC-roster-large and AC-roster-tests are verbatim from WI-03d (and ST-03); the three children's union covers all three parent criteria, with named final proof owners (behavior half of the AC-roster-large floors owned headlessly here, AC-roster-count and the roster-wide test-existence/spoiler proof in WI-03d3). Dependencies are correct: no local dependencies, no ancestor/descendant dependency, story-level WI-03a/b/c ordering inherited through WI-03d so the announcement scenarios see other tiers' species, and d2/d3 depend on d1 acyclically. Boundaries are explicit and non-overlapping: section 52 presentation passes are WI-03d2's, production placement is WI-03d3's, ST-04 beats and ST-05 are out, and the sonar-scale signal is defined here as simulation state the renderer reads per section 13. Verification is focused (per-organism scenarios asserting fauna-announcement ordering before direct sight/sound and no-clean-view windows from sim visibility state, non-targetable check, tier-4 spoiler containment) with no whole-game fix-anything check, and the handoff names the files, request sections, source of truth, and a falsifiable assumption, so a fresh implementer can proceed without reconstructing the project.
